messages.en:
{07 14 00}Lately I've been collecting
clothes. It's tons of fun,
but it's not for everyone.
{07 00 00}Some folks would rather
collect hats or glasses or
umbrellas or something.
{07 14 00}But I think clothes are the
building blocks of fashion,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Viimasel ajal kogun ma
riideid. See on väga lõbus,
aga see pole kõigile.
{07 00 00}Mõned inimesed koguvad
pigem mütse või prille või
vihmavarje või midagi.
{07 14 00}Aga minu arust on riided
moe ehituskivid,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Believe it or not, {01 00 00 03 00}I'm really
getting into fashion!

{07 0d 00}I know!{01 00 00 05 00} It's crazy, huh?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
But I just LOVE collecting
clothes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Eh? {07 0b 00}You want to know why?
{07 14 00}Um... I'm not sure!{01 00 00 05 00} Ha ha!{01 00 00 05 00}
I guess it's a mystery!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Usu või mitte, {01 00 00 03 00}ma olen
tõesti moesse sattunud!

{07 0d 00}Ma tean!{01 00 00 05 00} Hullumeelne, mis?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Aga ma lihtsalt ARMASTAN
riiete kogumist, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Mis? {07 0b 00}Tahad teada, miks?
{07 14 00}Ee... Pole kindel!{01 00 00 05 00} Hah hah!{01 00 00 05 00}
See on vist mõistatus!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Lately, {01 00 00 05 00}all I can think of
are clothes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0e 00}I think I might be nuts...
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}But anyway, {04 1f 00}, if
you find any nice clothes,
please let me know!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Viimasel ajal {01 00 00 05 00}mõtlen ma
ainult riietele, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0e 00}Ma vist läksin hulluks...
{07 00 00}{07 14 00}Aga igatahes, {04 1f 00}, kui
sa leiad kenasid riideid,
anna mulle teada!
